_readme: FIAT GEAR - the four slings (30 Oct). Written by tools/make_slings_manifest.py; the same template as pixellab_items_parts_manifest.json. A job whose file exists is skipped.

jobs.description: A realistic painted pixel-art still-life of a single gun sling seen from above: a length of frayed blue baler-twine rope tied into a loop, knotted at both ends, loosely coiled, plain and unprinted, filling the frame. One object centred and filling the frame, soft directional overcast daylight, natural material rendering with fine detail and painterly shading; no black outlines, no flat cel shading, not anime, not a cartoon, not a glossy video-game item; the look of a real object photographed on a grey day in a country that has run out of money. Muted cool northern palette, worn and repaired, nothing new. Nothing else in the frame, no gun, no hands, no person, no text, no logos, no floor, wall, ground or sky around it, a plain dark neutral background.
